notes: One white Hindustan Ambassador filmed twice in different light (uCO3D pair C). The pickup walk goes front, right side, rear; the return walk goes rear, right side, front, so the left side is only seen at the corners. I saw no new damage: the trunk chips and the right front door chip are in both walks. Each reference mark's t is a 15 fps proxy slot (k/15 s, to 6 places) and its point is in original pixels (1920x1080) of the frame the slot shows. They were first read at 16.43002, 9.533469, 1.521298 and 8.01217 s, on source frames between slots, then moved on Oct 31 to the slot frame by template matching and checked by eye. Coverage follows eval/README.md: filmed is at least 85% of the panel in the frame, in focus, at 3% of the frame or more; the pickup windshield was read again under that wording and stays glimpsed (about half of it is above the frame).
